title: THE LAST TRAIN
message: The next opportunity may not wait for you.
meaning:
The Last Train is an urgent choice with a limited window. The departure is already underway, and a decision postponed is a decision made.

The card asks what you would choose if you knew there would be no later.
imageAlt: A long empty platform with a train almost vanishing into fog. One carriage appears twice in different places, like an error in the image.
